instruction: Implement a fixed-capacity LRU (least-recently-used) cache in the target file, replacing the stub. Provide `pub struct Lru` with: `pub fn new(cap: usize) -> Self`; `pub fn get(&mut self, key: i64) -> Option<i64>` returning the value and marking the key most-recently-used; `pub fn put(&mut self, key: i64, val: i64)` inserting/updating and marking most-recently-used, evicting the least-recently-used entry when at capacity. Both get and put count as a use. Standard LeetCode-146 semantics. Edit only this file; do not use external crates.
